# State compatibility fixtures

`v0.1.0-rc.5/` was generated with 0.1.0-rc.5+9a8e055936aa from Homebrew in a new private temporary state directory, using two disposable Cursor SessionStart hooks and a diagnostic send. No live state or native client models were used. Synthetic capabilities were not retained; only journal hashes remain. Native configuration directories were normalized to `/fixture/cursor`, and process ownership was removed so fixtures remain portable.

Released binary SHA-256: `9a8e055936aabaf42b6c32aae9e235a40f4c24b4f130012aedf9e88fc188a718`.

`schema-2-lease/` extends the second rc.5 session with a synthetic current lease. Its endpoint identifiers are inert fixture values, and `future_lease` exercises preservation within a supported schema.
